# 龙的天空 (Longkong.com)

> > A vibrant Chinese web literature community platform dedicated to novel discussions, reader engagement, and creative writing across multiple genres.

龙的天空 (Longkong) is a major hub for Chinese fiction enthusiasts, offering a space for readers to discuss web novels, share reviews, and connect with other literature fans. The platform provides both web and mobile access to its community features.

## Core Platform

- [龙的天空网络文学 - 龙空](https://www.lkong.com): Homepage for Longkong, a web literature community platform for Chinese fiction discussions and novel reviews.
